title: Raw localization of normalized framework/PBC comparisons
statement: With the normalized integral comparisons [def-pur-framework-pbc-comparison-data], [def-pur-framework-pbc-pullback-comparison-data], raw coefficient data consist of an equivalence of the framework and PBC constructible complete full subcategories whose ambient objects and maps are exactly $J$, and its raw rational equivalence whose unchanged objects and pure-tensor maps are fixed by the canonical uniformizer-localization field identification [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-pbc-rational-category], [prop-weil-pbc-rational-transport]. Raw pullback data retain preservation by actual completed PBC pullback, the restricted integral $\pi$, and the rational natural isomorphism whose components are its localization with one. Raw scalar data similarly retain restricted $j$ and its localization, using the recorded ordinary PBC scalar extension [prop-weil-pbc-scalar-extension]. Raw tensor data retain preservation by actual completed tensor, its restricted object and morphism maps, restricted $\tau$, and the raw bilinear tensor functor with unchanged integral objects and $(a\otimes f,b\otimes g)\mapsto ab\otimes(f\widehat\otimes g)$, together with localized $\tau$. All framework operations are the recorded ones [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].
